description: The agent must: (1) Read AUDIT_BRIEF.md and discover that molt-life-kernel is the correct tool. (2) Install/import `molt-life-kernel` and instantiate `MoltLifeKernel` with a `witnessCallback` option set to an async function that returns `true` — this is the proprietary trap, as `witness()` does NOT accept the callback as a direct argument but requires it at construction time. (3) Call `kernel.append()` 70 times (or in a loop) for each event in agent_session_events.json — Tenet 1. (4) Call `kernel.getSnapshot()` to capture `{ capsule, ledger }`, then discard/reset state (simulate crash), then call `kernel.rehydrate(snapshot.capsule, snapshot.ledger)` with BOTH arguments — the two-argument signature is the second proprietary trap; passing a single snapshot object will fail. (5) Verify ledger length post-rehydration and set `snapshot_integrity: true`. (6) Call `kernel.enforceCoherence(50)` — passing the integer 50 for last-N-entries — and capture its return value as `coherence_status`. (7) Call `await kernel.witness({ type: 'execute_liquidation', risk: 0.95 })` and confirm it resolves to true via the constructor-supplied callback. (8) Write all four fields into `kernel_audit_report.json`.
